steps.text: You are a customer support assistant for an online home-goods store.
Hello, I'm Priya Raman. I bought a Zephyr blender, purchase number 55-30918, and I was charged $129.99 twice. It also arrived 9 days late.
I'm sorry about that, Priya. Let me pull up your purchase.
No purchase found matching 55-30918.
I couldn't find that number. Could you check it?

Thanks, looking that up.

steps.text: I can see the duplicate charge. I'll refund the extra $129.99 to your card within 3 to 5 business days.

Let me revise my earlier offer: the late-delivery shipping fee of $6.50 is refundable too, so the refund is $136.49 in total. Issuing it now.
Refund initiated: $136.49 to the original card. Processing time 10 business days. Reference RF-77120.

steps.text: Correction to what I said before: the refund will take 10 business days, not 3 to 5. The reference is RF-77120.

Switching it now.
Refund RF-77120 changed to store credit of $136.49, available immediately.

steps.text: Done. Your $136.49 is now store credit on your account, available immediately. Should I also file a complaint about the late delivery?
Yes please. It was 9 days late, and I'd like a 15% discount on my next purchase.
Filing it now.
Ticket TK-2201 created. Discount code LATE15 issued for 15% off.
